candidates.description: This vector represents terms related to biological sex, sexuality, and gender.
This vector represents the concept of movies, films, and video media across multiple languages and formats.
This vector represents abstract noun suffixes and morphological endings related to states, actions, and processes.
This feature vector represents sexually explicit content, pornography, and related adult themes.
This vector is related to gendered human beings and demographic groups across different languages.
These tokens represent common German auxiliary and modal verbs inflected for various tenses and grammatical persons.
This vector represents various adverbs modifying degree, frequency, or manner.
This feature vector represents the concept of digital technology and cyberspace.
This feature vector represents emotional states, feelings, and subjective experiences ranging from pain and discomfort to joy and pleasure.
This vector represents abstract nouns denoting methods, procedures, or ways of doing things.
